gaps.title: Habanera (from Rapsodie espagnole, M. 54) (arr. Kreisler)
gaps.edition: Fritz Kreisler; New York: Charles Foley, 1928 (plate 24723); a Schott violin-and-piano edition is also listed by Boosey & Hawkes
gaps.note: Movement III of the Rapsodie espagnole (same music as the two-piano Habanera M. 8). Kreisler recorded it for Victor on 30 Nov 1928 (unissued on 78 rpm, reissued by Naxos per DAHR/track listings). Do not confuse with the Pièce en forme de habanera (M. 51), already listed.

gaps.title: Forlane (from Le Tombeau de Couperin, M. 68) (arr. Heifetz)
gaps.edition: Carl Fischer, The Jascha Heifetz Series (CF B2611), copyright 1942, 16 pp. score and part
gaps.note: Published Heifetz transcription of movement 3 of the piano suite. I could not confirm a Heifetz recording of it (his Ravel discography shows Tzigane, Valses nobles 6 and 7, Sonatine minuet, Habanera), so the 'recorded' criterion is unverified.

gaps.title: Menuet (from Le Tombeau de Couperin, M. 68) (arr. Dushkin)
gaps.edition: Samuel Dushkin; Durand, separate extract (11 pp., code DR01140801) and in Ravel Collection for Violin Vol. 2 (Durand DR01636600)
gaps.note: Standalone Durand edition sold by Hal Leonard/Durand retailers; no recording found.

gaps.title: Rigaudon (from Le Tombeau de Couperin, M. 68) (arr. Dushkin)
gaps.edition: Samuel Dushkin; Durand, Recueil pour violon / Ravel Collection for Violin Vol. 1 (2013 collection of earlier Durand transcriptions)
gaps.note: Listed in the Durand collection contents as 'transcription pour violon et piano de S. Dushkin'. No recording found.

gaps.title: Pastourelle (from L'Enfant et les sortilèges, M. 71) (arr. Dushkin)
gaps.edition: Samuel Dushkin; Durand, Recueil pour violon / Ravel Collection for Violin Vol. 1 (2013)
gaps.note: Credited to S. Dushkin in the CiNii record of the Durand collection (one retailer summary did not name the arranger). Same Durand volume also has Lemaitre's Pavane de la Belle au bois dormant, Asselin's Five o'clock fox-trot and Branga's Boléro, deliberately not proposed (lesser-known arrangers, no recordings found).

gaps.title: Menuet (from Sonatine, M. 40) (arr. Roques)
gaps.edition: Leon Roques; Durand (in Recueil pour violon / Ravel Collection for Violin Vol. 1, 2013)
gaps.note: Heifetz recorded the Sonatine minuet (Naxos Heifetz Encores Vol. 1, Brooks Smith/Emanuel Bay), but the sources do not say whose arrangement he used; Roques's is the published Durand version. IMSLP lists only a Roques cello version of this movement.

existing_issues.issue: Arranger missing. IMSLP lists two violin versions: Paul Kochanski (Paris: Max Eschig, 1927, plate M.E. 1867) and Louis Fleury (flute or violin and piano, Paris: E. Demets, 1909, plate E. 1463 D.; reissued in Durand's Recueil pour violon). Kochanski's is the notable-violinist version. M. 19.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Pavane pour une infante défunte, M. 19 (arr. Kochański)

existing_issues.issue: Arranger missing and M. number: Ravel's Vocalise-étude en forme de habanera is M. 51 (1907, bass voice and piano). The Leduc violin and piano edition (AL 24864) is credited to Georges Catherine per Boosey & Hawkes listing; IMSLP also lists a Doney arrangement for flute/oboe/violin and piano (Leduc 1921, A.L. 16171). Heifetz recorded the Catherine version.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Pièce en forme de habanera, M. 51 (arr. Catherine)

existing_issues.issue: Key missing: IMSLP gives A minor (ends in C major), M. 73, 1920-22.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Sonata for Violin and Cello in A minor, M. 73
